metric_definitions.elapsed_s: Monotonic seconds from trial start through hash verification or terminal error.
metric_definitions.bytes_sent: Upload body bytes read at proxy ingress, including repeated and discarded bytes. Excludes HTTP headers and unread OS buffers.
metric_definitions.client_submitted_bytes: Body bytes submitted by the client to its socket; may include buffered bytes never read by the proxy.
metric_definitions.forwarded_bytes: Body bytes submitted by the proxy to the origin socket; excludes headers. Not a wire-level measurement.
metric_definitions.confirmed_bytes: Server-confirmed contiguous committed payload bytes. Full uploads and resumable chunks commit atomically.
metric_definitions.retransmission_bytes: max(0, proxy ingress bytes minus final origin committed unique bytes). Repeated/discarded application work, including failed partial bodies.
metric_definitions.overhead_percent: 100 * retransmission_bytes / payload bytes; available for verified successes only.
metric_definitions.useful_kbps: Verified payload bytes * 8 / elapsed seconds / 1000 on success; unavailable on failure.
metric_definitions.recovery_s: Per restored phase: seconds from scheduled restoration to first subsequent acknowledgement that increases confirmed bytes; null when unobserved.
metric_definitions.retry_count: Additional upload attempts begun after failure. Offset probes and successful chunks are not retries.
metric_definitions.success_rate: Verified successes / completed trials in the same strategy/configuration cell. Cancelled trials excluded.
metric_definitions.integrity: SHA-256 of original payload compared with SHA-256 of committed origin bytes; null unless a complete file is verified.
metric_definitions.transport_overhead: Unavailable: TCP/IP headers, packet loss and TCP retransmissions are not measured.
